title: Cottage Pie with Chinese Twist
description: A comforting Chinese-inspired cottage pie made with ground beef, crunchy knotted bread crumbs, and creamy cottage cheese.
instructions: Cook the ground beef in a pan over medium-high heat until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Stir in soy sauce, ginger, garlic, salt, and pepper, and continue to cook for another 2-3 minutes.
Stir in cottage cheese and cook until heated through.
In a separate pan, toast the bread crumbs over medium heat until crispy.
To assemble the pie, spread the beef mixture in the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Top the beef mixture with the toasted bread crumbs and then with the crumbled cottage cheese.
Bake the pie in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the filling is hot and bubbly.
Garnish with chopped green onions and scallions before serving.
